subject: Pre-launch MAP: integration task sync and owners
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@integracom.com>

Cc: Victor Huang <victor.huang@integracom.com>, eng-team@integracom.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-launch MAP: integration task sync

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the call last week — we wanted to kick off a weekly checkpoint cadence in the mutual action plan (MAP) to keep the pre-launch integration on schedule. Our PM (Victor) and two engineers will join recurring syncs. High-level asks from Integracom:

- Confirm SDK compatibility (Python, Node) and recommended pinned versions.
- Auth: guide on token exchange + short-lived key rotation (staging & prod).
- Streaming: sample for partial response handling and reconnect behavior.
- Tool calling: example payloads we can validate against our toolchain.
- Close timeline: target production go-live 2026-09-10; we need validation testing completed by 2026-08-25.

Can you send a short tracking doc with action owners and current status so we can align before our technical kickoff tomorrow?

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Senior Product Manager
Integracom

--

Hi Elena / Victor,

Appreciate the clear priorities — we'll run a short weekly MAP checkpoint each Tuesday at 10am PT starting tomorrow. I've drafted a compact task tracker below (more detail to come from Aditya). Please scan and flag anything missing.

Proposed agenda for 30m recurring:
- 5m: blockers and quick runway check
- 15m: task review (SDK, auth, streaming, tool calls)
- 5m: test schedule & signoff criteria
- 5m: next steps and owners

Immediate asks from our side: please share the staging API endpoints and any corp firewall IP allowlist before EOD so Aditya can provision test tokens.

I'll attach the MAP checklist and the draft SLA we discussed. Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/mtg-integ-sync

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@integracom.com>, Victor Huang <victor.huang@integracom.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-launch MAP: integration task sync — integration task log (owners + due dates)

Hi all — following our 8/19 tech sync, here is the concrete integration task tracking I promised. I put estimated effort and the primary owner for each line. I'll drop the sample auth config to the thread (see attachment).

1) SDK validation (Python/Node) — owner: Aditya Rao — status: In progress
   - Task: Validate Redwood SDK v2.1.0 against Integracom's request/response patterns
   - Subtasks: run end-to-end sample (text-gen, streaming) + pin recommended versions
   - Due: 2026-08-22

2) Auth flow & token rotation — owner: Monica Patel (CS) — status: Blocked (waiting for staging IPs)
   - Task: Provide token exchange example for short-lived tokens (OAuth client_assertion + rotation notes).
   - Deliverable: sample-auth-config.yaml + rotation doc
   - Due: 2026-08-21
   - Notes: Integracom to provide staging endpoints and allowlist. Monica: will also provide a temporary staging key for integration tests.

3) Streaming reliability & reconnects — owner: Aditya Rao — status: Ready for test
   - Task: Share sample streaming client code (resume on reconnect, idempotency keys) and failure-mode guidance
   - Deliverable: streaming-samples.zip (code snippets)
   - Due: 2026-08-23

4) Tool calling / structured outputs — owner: Rishi Malhotra — status: In review
   - Task: Provide canonical payloads for tool invocation, schema validation, and example tool adapters
   - Deliverable: tool-calls-spec.md
   - Due: 2026-08-24

5) Rate limits & backpressure tuning — owner: Aditya Rao — status: Draft
   - Task: Provide recommended token-level rate limits for peak inference and guidance on auto-retry/backoff
   - Due: 2026-08-25

Action items agreed on call:
- Integracom: share staging endpoints + allowlist by EOD 8/19 (Victor)
- Redwood (Monica): provide test staging key and sample-auth-config.yaml by 8/21
- Redwood (Aditya): post streaming samples and SDK checklist by 8/22
- Redwood (Rishi): finalize tool-calls-spec by 8/24

Notes about risk: short timeline to validation (target 8/25) — if staging credentials arrive late we'll recommend a focused smoke test plan to reduce risk.

Attachment: sample-auth-config.yaml

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
